jessica-support: customer reported break after bumping to @redwood/sdk-js v0.22.0. first request returns 404 for sessions.create, subsequent retries show 403 Invalid API key. Node 18, TS/Node runtime.

samir-eng: can you paste exact error and short repro? are they using our managed rotating token?

jessica-support: repro steps:
1) npm i @redwood/sdk-js@0.22.0
2) process.env.RW_KEY set to managed token
3) code:
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/sdk-js')
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
await client.sessions.create({ user_id: 'u123' })
```
error logs: `404 Not Found: /v1/sessions.create` then `403 Invalid API key` on next attempt.

olivia-eng: I think this matches a change we shipped in v0.22: we removed some convenience wrappers (sessions.create) and switched default raw path mapping. SDK now prefers `client.request({ path: '/v1/sessions', method: 'POST', body })` or the new `client.authToken` field for auth. Release notes mentioned it but easy to miss.

ben-cs: customer didn't touch code, just did a patch bump. They're on v0.22 across multiple deployments. They're asking for quick fix or rollback option.

samir-eng: quick checklist: confirm lockfile to rule out mixed installs, check whether header name changed (Authorization -> X-Redwood-Auth) and validate token rotation behavior. Rotating token mid-process can surface as 403s.

jessica-support: lockfile shows only v0.22.0. logs show sequence: first call 404, then 403s. token rotation window is 15m.

olivia-eng: action: we can ship a compatibility shim in a patch (v0.22.1) that restores sessions.create to call the raw request path and ensure Authorization header is set for managed tokens. Workaround for customers: pin to @redwood/sdk-js@0.21.4 or use raw request surface:
```js
await client.request({ path: '/v1/sessions', method: 'POST', body: { user_id: 'u123' } })
```
Also confirm RW_KEY env var isn't being reloaded in serverless/container restarts during rotation.

support-bot: Ticket INC-3421 created and linked to eng-runtime, priority P2.

ben-cs: customer prefers a patch over pinning. can we get a small compatibility shim?

samir-eng: filing PR to add shim and to add explicit header fallback. will include unit test for token rotation. ETA ~4 hours if review is smooth.

jessica-support: relaying ETA to customer, they asked for rollback if patch will take too long.

olivia-eng: if we cut v0.22.1, I'll add release notes and post to #eng-releases and #support with mitigation steps. Also adding monitoring for 404->403 pattern to catch regressions.

ben-cs: sent workaround + pin instructions to customer, included raw request snippet. :thumbsup:

samir-eng: follow-up note: in serverless, env var refresh (token rotation) can lead to auth failures if long-lived SDK instances pick up partial state. adding defensive checks in SDK init should help.

jessica-support: marking INC-3421 as responding. will update when patch lands.

support-bot: INC-3421 updated: assignees samir-eng, olivia-eng, status "in progress"
